description: Land Acquisition - Mehiella, Mallwapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters including land acquisitions, transfers, and property ownership details.
